title: Ovicopter
move_pattern: Starts with Lay Eggs. Cycles: Lay Eggs → Smash → Tenderizer → decision point. At the decision point: if 3 or fewer allies are alive, repeats Lay Eggs; if 4 or more alive, uses Nutritional Paste → Smash → Tenderizer → back to decision point.
notes: Ovicopter summons ToughEgg allies with Minion power to reinforce its position. Its move pattern is adaptive: when it has accumulated too many allies (more than 3), it stops summoning and instead self-buffs with Strength to increase damage output. Tenderizer move is hidden from bestiary preview.
